Report the final density of the system in g/cm³.

Thought: The CIF structure has been successfully converted into a LAMMPS data file. Now, I need to create a LAMMPS input script using the specified simulation parameters. This script will define the simulation process, including the use of the EAM potential, equilibration under NVT, relaxation under NPT, and heating to induce melting. I will write this input script next.
Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/melting/brief/tasks/magnesium_melting_trial_3/melting_simulation.in", "content": "
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data magnesium_structure.data

pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg.eam.alloy Mg

neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 10

timestep 0.001

# NVT Equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT Relaxation
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT Heating
fix 1 all npt temp 300 2000 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000
unfix 1

# Output final density
variable density equal mass(all)/vol
print "Final density: ${density} g/cm^3"
"}
